patch.objective: Apply the nursing process -- assess, diagnose, plan, implement, evaluate -- to a changing med-surg patient
secondaryObjectives: Prioritize a patient assignment and recognize which patient to see first
Call the rapid response team on early warning signs of deterioration

sources.cite: MSNCB, 2023 CMSRN Exam Blueprint: Patient/Care Management (32%)
sources.note: Relayed from the CMSRN course seed (backend/supabase/seed/tracks/cmsrn.ts), which read the blueprint 2026-11-14, not re-read for this band. Patient/Care Management covers the nursing process, safety, medication and pre- and post-procedure care. Scope only.
The objective and secondary objectives are the course's own titles.

sources.cite: Prescott HC, et al. Surviving Sepsis Campaign: International Guidelines for Management of Sepsis and Septic Shock 2026. Crit Care Med 2026;54(4)
sources.note: Relayed from the NCLEX-RN case med-surg-deterioration-sbar, not re-read for this band; its note: As relayed by secondary summaries (read for the CCRN sepsis case 2026-11-10, not re-read): antimicrobials immediately, ideally within 1 h, in possible septic shock; cultures first only without delaying the dose; crystalloid first line; lactate measured. The primary text was not opened.
